notes.title: Major upgrade
notes.notes:
1. Expanded the map for each level. Increased the number of enemies.
2. Three new enemies have been added, along with a variety of new items and traps.
3. Modified some game parameters.
Increases the overall difficulty of the game, making the combat more exciting.
